Hero_Desc_Ifrit:
Expert at getting angry without cause or justification.
It is rumored that she can adeptly manage her anger and secretly chooses who to be angry with.
Album_Ifrit1: Ifrit is said to be the youngest among the high-ranking elementals in Elias. For someone so young, she is uncharacteristically very rigid. But then again, being an elemental, she's probably quite old.
Album_Ifrit2: Just as the fire's path is determined by the direction of the wind, it is said she is very good at following the wind elemental, Sylla. Not surprisingly, the elemental with whom she shares the worst relationship is... the water elemental, Naia. Could this not only be because fire and water are polar opposites, but also because Naia's pranks could prove fatal for Ifrit?
Album_Ifrit3: They say she normally resides within a dormant volcano and is afraid of accidentally burning things if she carelessly wanders outside. Contrary to her fierce appearance, she seems to have a tender heart.
Album_Ifrit4: Ifrit deeply cherishes the lesser fire elementals. And with such terrifying tales of fire elementals completely burning up, leading to their total annihilation, in such times of danger, she asks Sylla, the wind elemental, for help keep the embers alive.
Album_Ifrit5: Some time in the past, the dormant volcano, where Ifrit and the lesser elementals reside, experienced a massive eruption. At that time, all elementals were united, barely able to prevent a disaster. Ifrit seems to miss those days when all elementals combined their powers and worked together.
Album_Ifrit6: Ifrit claims to have one archenemy. When asked if it's the water elemental Naia, she dismissively waves her hand no. Ifrit's real archenemy is... aluminum foil.
Album_Ifrit7: Sometimes, Ifrit helps burn the trash that Naia pulls from the lake. That's how she first discovered aluminum foil, used as a bread wrapper. No matter how much intense firepower she unleashed, the foil refused to burn. That day, for the first time in her life, Ifrit felt fear...

Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Hate1: As soon as Ifrit came close to it, it melted. She left, angry.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Hate2: Ifrit glared at the food, angrily demanding to know whether it was hot or cold before vaporizing it.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Like1:
Ifrit really liked the food since it didn't turn into coal when she put it in her mouth. 
The taste seems to be irrelevant.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Like2: Ifrit liked the food, saying it smelled like her.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Like3: This melts in your mouth right away, turning into a gummy candy-like texture, which is delightful.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Like4: When Ifrit picks them up, they become roasted rice cakes. They look delightful.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Like5: Hesitant as if it might catch fire, but she began to enjoy it after it popped.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Like6: Ifrit ate it vigorously, saying it looked like the kindling used for snacks.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Like7: Ifrit wished the broth was hotter, so we turned up the heat, but then the rice cakes began to stick. We had to intervene before a fire started at the Banquet Hall.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Like8: Watching the Almond Pralines melt due to her body temperature, Ifrit seemed to feel an inexplicable sense of accomplishment.
Food_ChefNote_Ifrit_Like9: After trying a few candies with an elemental theme, Ifrit seemed surprised. They don't melt even when she touches them...

LoveLetter_Ifrit: Hey, Master! Ifrit here!Writing letters is harder than I thought. The paper keeps catching fire, so this is already my fourth try. Anyway, it's nothing big, but I just wanted to say thanks for listening to me whine and putting up with me all this time.Oh, and I heard from the lesser fire elementals in the Banquet Hall that you've been nice to them, too. Honestly, you seem like someone I can trust. Let's keep this good thing we have going!
LoveCall_Ifrit:
Hello? It is me, Ifrit. This is the Master's number, right?

Have you been cold lately? If your room feels chilly, tell me anytime. I can come over whenever you like and warm it up.

Or how about visiting my room? I recently had Naia create a hot spring near my dwelling, and it is bubbling away. Members of the other races love it. I am sure you would too, Master.

After the hot spring, I have even prepared an atmospheric course with a campfire near Elemental Mountain... So whenever you want to spend a comfortable, relaxing time, just say the word.

The great Ifrit never refuses a friend's request. Ah, did that sound too much like an advertisement for a tourist attraction? It is not really an advertisement, so do not misunderstand.

Take care, Master. I will call you again sometime!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP01_001: I hurt others whenever I get too close to them. Is there a good way to make friends?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP01_002: Get even closer to them and hug them even tighter in those situations.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP01_003: You're making fun of me, right? You enjoying this?!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP01_004: Let's make a flame-resistant hazmat suit for free hugs in Monatium.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP01_005: Haz... what? Get help from elves? I wish there was another solution...
Affinity_Ifrit_EP01_006: You should accept the way you are and talk it through with others...
Affinity_Ifrit_EP01_007: Yeah, it can't be helped that everyone's too weak to endure my heat. Guess I should enroll in conversation classes or something.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP02_001: Do you think it's right to do whatever your friends ask for?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP02_002: It depends on what they ask. Who's asking?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP02_003: Th-That's private! Don't pry! Just answer the question!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP02_004: You should say no if you don't want to do it.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP02_005: Right...? Sometimes they ask for things that go a little too far...
Affinity_Ifrit_EP02_006: You're a sucker if you do favors for others. Life is a solitary path.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP02_007: Are you calling me a sucker? You want me to set this holy Order of yours on fire?!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP03_001: I wonder what ice tastes like. I'd like to taste it someday, even if it's just a tiny piece.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP03_002: I'm curious... have you ever had a drink of water?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP03_003: Water? That's a drink that bubbles and fizzles into steam when you drink it. Why?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP03_004: Don't worry, ice has no taste.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP03_005: You only say that because you've already tried it! Are you showing off right now?!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP03_006: Ice is a fantastic addition to any drink.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP03_007: I thought so. Sigh... I really wanna try it...!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP04_001: I find it exhausting to make up with friends every time we fight. I wanna change my fiery personality...
Affinity_Ifrit_EP04_002: Why don't you try not fighting to begin with?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP04_003: Are you serious? How can you go through life without fighting even once?! You trying to pick a fight with me right now?!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP04_004: Just apologize first and let whatever happens happen after that.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP04_005: Apologize first...? You think that will work? Maybe I'll try that.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP04_006: Hide from them until things deescalate from "angry" to "slightly awkward."
Affinity_Ifrit_EP04_007: Actually, I'm doing that right now... but it's been over 100 years, and I don't know if it's working.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP05_001: Do you always hold back your anger? You should just let it out, like me!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP05_002: Only children express their anger right away like that.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP05_003: What?! Don't treat me like a child, you're much younger than me!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP05_004: I have moments like that, too, where I just explode and let it all out.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP05_005: Right, you live with sprites, so I guess that's inevitable.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP05_007: You sure bottling it up isn't just giving you ulcers?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP06_001: I don't know why everyone's always trying to hold on to something. Everything turns to ashes once they burn.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP06_002: Don't you have anything you treasure?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP06_004: I guess you shouldn't eat food either, since it's gone once you eat it.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP06_006: I think that's something only a fire elemental would understand.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP06_007: You can't even understand this? How can you be this foolish...
Affinity_Ifrit_EP07_001: What is something you like? I don't seem to have ever asked.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP07_002: The smell of fresh napalm in the morning.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP07_003: Really? We have something in common, huh?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP07_004: A lizard in ice with fluffy feathers.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP07_005: Does something like that even exist? You're pulling my leg, aren't you?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP07_006: Why do you ask? You're up to something, aren't you?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP07_007: I need to know so that I can offer you gifts... or threaten you.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP08_001: The oven at your banquet hall seems a little underpowered. Have you thought of cooking with more heat?

Affinity_Ifrit_EP08_003: That's the whole point! That's what brings out the flavor!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP08_004: If you've got a problem with that, why don't you hop in the oven yourself?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP08_005: Hmph, you think I can't? I'll have the oven get as hot as the sun!
Affinity_Ifrit_EP08_006: My banquet hall, my rules. Don't butt in.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP08_007: Sigh... you're so stubborn. Oh well, I guess it's good you have such resolve.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP09_001: There are so many flammable things in here. Be careful.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP09_002: I thought you liked burning everything?
Affinity_Ifrit_EP09_003: Are you serious? I'm not that simple, you know.
Affinity_Ifrit_EP09_004: Don't worry, I've got fire insurance.

Affinity_Ifrit_EP09_007:
Oh, so this won't burn as easily?
How interesting... Does it really not burn? Even if I do this? Or this?
